from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyLiability(BaseModel):
    """Total liabilities reported by a single company in their financial statement."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the financial report")
    liability_total: str | None = Field(description="The total liabilities figure as reported, including currency symbol if present")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency of the reported figure, e.g., '元', 'USD'")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    balance_sheet_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of balance sheet, e.g., '合并资产负债表'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_liabilities: list[CompanyLiability]
